description: Write a Slack message for the user, to a person (`to`: their name, email or Slack id) or a channel (`channel_id`). Nothing posts. Chat shows it the way Slack will draw it, with Copy and Open in Slack; for a channel the bot is in, a Send button posts it as YouSpot only when the user taps it. A message to a person is pasted into their DM by the user, because YouSpot cannot write as them. Use this whenever the user asks you to write, draft or prepare a Slack message, and call it again with the revised text when they want changes. Write in the user's voice: short paragraphs, '- ' bullets, **bold** for the one thing that matters, [label](url) links, and <@U…> to mention someone by Slack id.

channel_id.description: The channel it is for (C… id), from list_slack_channels.

team_id.description: The workspace, when the user has more than one.

thread_ts.description: Reply in this thread of the channel.

to.description: The person it is for: name, email or Slack user id (U…).
